name: Sasanka Karunarathna
tagline: 4th-year Software Engineering undergraduate at SLIIT · Software Engineer intern at TS Technologies
pitch: I build fast, clean interfaces backed by solid full-stack fundamentals, from React front-ends to the APIs and databases behind them. I care about the details that don't show up in a demo — accessibility, performance, and code that's easy to change later.
bio: I'm a 4th-year Software Engineering undergraduate at SLIIT, currently holding a 3.9/4.0 GPA and a spot on the Dean's List for 2023 and 2024. Alongside my degree, I work as a Software Engineer Intern at TS Technologies, building front-end features for real products used by real teams. I like taking a design and turning it into an interface that's fast, accessible, and holds up under actual use, not just in a demo. After I graduate, I'm looking for a software engineering or front-end role where I can keep building things people rely on.
